name: outcome
wording: What the lead hands the architect when a story ends: which acceptance criteria hold, each with its evidence, the meaning questions it raised, the follow-ups it leaves, and what it cost. The architect accepts the story done on it. A story ends merged or dropped; anything unfinished is a follow-up, never an open state of the story.
reason: The operator, 2026-10-15: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure; each role is defined by what it receives and hands over, each handover states what it must contain, and established practice is named rather than restated.
